subject: VALUE clause
notes: RE-VERDICTED 2026-09-09 (kb/Work PB505) -- SAME VERDICT, SAME MECHANISM, NEW NAME FOR THE CALL SITE. PB208's ValidateTableValues was SPLIT: its ALL-FORMATS literal screen kept its place at entry bind beside the format-1 call site and is now DataBinder.ScreenTableValueLiterals; the clause's GEOMETRY moved to the post-forest ResolveTableValues pass, because 13.18.63.3 SR18-SR23 are written against the entry's OCCURS ANCESTORS and DataItem.Parent does not exist while the entry binds. The literal screen deliberately did NOT move with it: SR2 is a property of the literal and the subject's own PICTURE, and keeping both formats on ONE timeline is what Format1AndFormat2_ScreenTheSameLiteralAlike pins. No behaviour change -- re-measured, `05 B PIC 9(4) COMP OCCURS 2 VALUE "0012" FROM (1) TO (2).` draws COBOL1657 at all four editions and the --permissive rewrite still reaches every occurrence. kb/Work PB4113: SR2's "range indicated by the PICTURE clause or the USAGE clause" for a fixed-width binary subject (NumericTruncation.BinaryCapacity: COMP-5, BINARY-*) is the USAGE's on the leading side: ValidateNumericValue asks AlgebraicRanges.Of's container band there and the PICTURE's digit span only for the trailing side (S99V99 COMP-5 VALUE 1.234 stays refused), so PIC 9(4) COMP-5 VALUE 65535 and PIC S9(4) COMP-5 VALUE -32768 are admitted at formats 1 to 3 and 65536 / -32769 refused naming the USAGE range (docs/CONFORMANCE.md DOC-A.1-208).
